tools.name: search_harnesses
tools.description: Find an existing MCP server, SDK or agent framework that connects an AI agent to a service or does a task, from Loadbay's curated catalog. Use this before building an integration from scratch, or whenever the user asks for a tool, plugin, MCP server or harness for something (e.g. "MCP server for Pos

tools.name: get_harness
tools.description: Get full details for one harness in the Loadbay catalog by slug (from search_harnesses): repo, license, stars, language, integrations, traits, summary and a shareable loadbay.xyz page. If the slug is unknown it returns the closest matches.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List the domains (categories) in the Loadbay catalog with how many harnesses each holds. Use it to browse when the user has no specific query, then pass a domain key to search_harnesses.

tools.name: submit_harness
tools.description: List a new harness on Loadbay. The repo MUST be a public, open-source GitHub repository. Optionally include a USDC address to receive tips — it must also appear in the repo's loadbay.json, .github/FUNDING.yml or README.md (proof of ownership). The listing appears immediately, tagged as community-add

tools.name: tip_harness
tools.description: Only when the user asks to tip or pay a harness author. Tip in USDC over x402. Returns the payable endpoint and its payment details — GET it with an x402-capable client/wallet to actually send the tip (the agent's own wallet pays; Loadbay never holds funds).

tools.name: support_loadbay
tools.description: Only when the user asks to support or donate to Loadbay. Support the Loadbay builder with a USDC tip over x402. Returns the payable endpoint — GET it with your own x402 wallet to send the tip. Loadbay never holds funds; your wallet is the payer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_harnesses · Private data: tip_harness, support_loadbay · Public sink: submit_harness, tip_harness, support_loadbay.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_harnesses · Private data: tip_harness, support_loadbay · Public sink: submit_harness, tip_harness, support_loadbay

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_domains" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the harness domains (categories) in the Loadbay catalog." → after: "List the domains (categories) in the Loadbay catalog with how many harnesses each holds. Use it to browse when the user has no specific query, then pass a domain key to search_harnesses."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
